name: org.machanism.machai:project-layout
description: Project Layout is a Java 8 utility library that gives build tools, repository scanners, generators, documentation tools, validators, and indexers a common model of a repository's conventional directory structure. Its org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout abstraction reports project-root-relative production source, test, documentation, and optional module paths. MavenProjectLayout reads pom.xml metadata and Maven defaults; GradleProjectLayout uses the Gradle Tooling API and conventional src/main, src/test, and src/site locations; JScriptProjectLayout reads package.json workspaces; PythonProjectLayout detects common Python indicators; and DefaultProjectLayout provides filesystem fallback module discovery. ProjectLayoutManager selects a layout from project descriptors, while ProjectProcessor recursively applies custom processing to a project or its modules. PomReader parses Maven POM models, exposes POM properties, and serializes Maven models. The library is intended to remove hard-coded build-system path rules when handling Maven, Gradle, JavaScript or TypeScript, Python, generic, and multi-module repositories.

usageContext: Python repositories with pyproject.toml or related indicators
Generic repositories and multi-module source trees
Build plugins, scanners, validators, generators, and documentation pipelines

constructors.description: Creates a Maven-specific layout. Configure it with a project root before reading Maven modules, source and resource roots, test roots, or the src/site documentation root.

examples.description: Creates and configures a Maven layout resolver for a real project directory. Resolve each returned root-relative path against layout.getProjectDir() before scanning it.

constructors.description: Creates a Gradle-specific layout that loads Gradle project information through the Gradle Tooling API and supplies conventional source, test, documentation, and child-module locations.

examples.description: Configures a Gradle layout for a repository and obtains its Gradle child-module names.

constructors.description: Creates a JavaScript or TypeScript layout that identifies package.json projects and expands package.json workspace glob patterns into module paths.

examples.description: Uses package.json workspace metadata to obtain module directories for a monorepo scanner.

constructors.description: Creates the fallback layout for repositories with no recognized build descriptor. Immediate non-excluded subdirectories are treated as module candidates; source, test, and documentation collections are empty.

examples.description: Uses the generic fallback to enumerate candidate modules in an otherwise unstructured repository.

features.name: detectProjectLayout
features.signature: public static org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout detectProjectLayout(java.io.File projectDir) throws java.io.FileNotFoundException
features.description: Detects and configures a layout for an existing project directory. Descriptor detection supports Maven pom.xml, Gradle build.gradle, JavaScript or TypeScript package.json, Python indicators, and the default filesystem fallback.

examples.description: Let a scanner select the correct layout instead of hard-coding build-system directory conventions.

features.name: getSources
features.description: Returns production source and resource roots as paths relative to the configured project root. Maven reads configured or default build roots; Gradle returns the conventional src/main root; layouts without implemented discovery return an empty collection.

examples.description: Converts root-relative source entries to filesystem paths before a source analysis operation.

features.name: getModules
features.description: Returns modules discovered from Maven parent metadata, Gradle child projects, JavaScript workspace patterns, or default immediate-subdirectory scanning. Maven and the base contract may return null for a non-parent project.

examples.description: Enumerates modules safely, including the non-parent case where the selected layout returns null.

features.name: scanFolder
features.signature: public void scanFolder(java.io.File projectDir) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Detects the layout for a project folder and processes either the folder itself or recursively discovered modules. Subclasses provide the concrete processing operation through processFolder(ProjectLayout).

examples.description: Implements project-specific indexing behavior and invokes it for each project or module found in a repository.

features.name: getProjectModel
features.description: Reads a Maven pom.xml into an Apache Maven Model after property substitution. PomReader also exposes parsed properties and can serialize a model as XML.

examples.description: Reads Maven artifact metadata for repository indexing or build diagnostics.

customizations.name: ProjectProcessor.processFolder
customizations.description: Extend ProjectProcessor and implement processFolder(org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout) to apply indexing, validation, generation, or metrics collection to every processed project folder.

examples.description: Defines a reusable processor that handles every discovered project using the common ProjectLayout contract.

customizations.name: ProjectLayout
customizations.description: Extend ProjectLayout to support a new build ecosystem or repository convention. Implement source, document, and test discovery and optionally customize module and project metadata discovery.

examples.description: Shows the minimum methods required for a custom root-relative directory convention.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout
studs.description: Common gateway contract for configured project roots and their root-relative source, test, documentation, and optional module locations.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.project.ProjectProcessor
studs.description: Gateway for recursive project and module processing; subclasses supply folder-specific behavior through processFolder.

examples.title: Install and run a layout-aware Maven scanner
examples.description: Project Layout is a Java library, not an executable Maven plugin. Install it as a dependency, compile the consuming application, then run the application with its normal entry point.
steps: Add the dependency configuration to the consuming Maven application's pom.xml.
Resolve the returned root-relative paths against org.machanism.machai.project.layout.ProjectLayout.getProjectDir().
Run mvn clean package, then invoke the application's configured main class or packaging artifact.

examples.title: Process all modules in a mixed repository
examples.description: Use ProjectProcessor when an indexing or validation tool must visit the root project and modules discovered using ecosystem-specific metadata.
steps: Install Project Layout using the Maven dependency shown in the previous example.
Implement processFolder with the scanner, validator, or generator operation.
Call scanFolder with the repository root from the application's command-line flow.
